resources.string: On the computer, open Throw via Direct Wi-Fi, scan and select this phone. Accept the connection on the phone, then approve Throw on the computer.
Direct Wi-Fi is unavailable. Check that Wi-Fi is enabled, or use the current network.
Direct Wi-Fi needs the nearby Wi-Fi permission (location permission on older Android versions).
Another Wi-Fi Direct session is active or starting. Stop it before starting this connection.
Direct Wi-Fi did not become ready. Check Wi-Fi and try again.
The direct Wi-Fi connection ended. Start again to reconnect.
Direct Wi-Fi connected. Approve this phone in Throw on the computer, then choose what to share.
